resources.string: Bénin IN Groupe POC: share your PID with a proximity reader (ISO 18013-5)
Open the ANIP Bénin issuer portal
Turn your passport or ID card into a digital identity (PID), issued by ANIP Bénin and kept securely on this phone.
Place the phone flat on the passport (or the ID card) and keep still. The chip is read over NFC and checked by ANIP Bénin — Passive, Active and Chip Authentication.
Blink and turn your head when asked, then look at the camera. ANIP Bénin compares your face with the photo from the chip or the document before issuing your PID.
